hero.title: Spend Less Time on Paperwork. More Time With Patients.
hero.subtitle: Staptis turns your consultation recordings into structured, editable medical reports — securely and instantly.

problem.title: Still spending hours writing reports after every consultation?
problem.description: Staptis lets you focus on patients while we handle the paperwork — accurately and automatically.

bullet1.title: Free yourself from administrative overhead
bullet1.description: Stop losing time on repetitive documentation. Free your evenings and improve your workflow.

bullet2.title: Get structured reports instantly
bullet2.description: We turn consultation audio into clean, editable reports — ready for your EMR.

bullet3.title: Reduce cognitive load & burnout
bullet3.description: Stay present with your patients. Let us handle the admin so you don’t have to.

step1.title: Choose Your Template
step1.description: Explore a curated selection of medical templates tailored to various specialties and cases.

step2.title: Add Medical Context
step2.description: Capture patient details seamlessly—either through live consultation transcription or manual entry—empowering AI to generate accurate medical notes.

step3.title: Review & Refine
step3.description: Customize your documentation effortlessly. Staptis also analyzes notes to extract relevant SNOMED CT codes and translates medical jargon into patient-friendly language for clearer communication.

step4.title: Deliver & Integrate
step4.description: Generate finalized reports such as consultation letters, referrals, or certificates, ready to share or integrate with your electronic health records.

vision.title: Our Mission & Vision
vision.description: At Staptis, we believe in using technology to return time to healthcare providers and improve clarity for patients. Our goal is to make clinical documentation effortless, accurate, and accessible.

culture.title: Our Culture
culture.description: We’re driven by purpose and grounded in values that help us build for the long term.

kindness.title: Kindness
kindness.description: We communicate with empathy, assume positive intent, and treat everyone with respect—inside and outside our company.

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.description: We take responsibility, follow through, and act as stewards of our product and our users' trust.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.description: We pursue high standards in everything we do, from code to care, always striving to improve.

pragmatism.title: Pragmatism
pragmatism.description: We seek simple, practical solutions to real-world problems without overengineering.
